title: Pricing · matrix (collapsible)
description: ServiceWand plan comparison matrix. Static fallback is driven by column_count and numbered rows; dynamic mode rebuilds columns, groups, rows, and mobile accordions for every plan and visible Core PIM attribute returned by the pricing API.

source.adapted_from: Information architecture reference only — grouped plan-vs-feature matrix. Second-opinion variant alongside pricing.comparison-matrix: mobile becomes a per-plan accordion (each plan is a disclosure), states drive cell glyphs (yes/no/partial/text), groups and rows can be hidden via ENUM.
source.decision: Stage 1 pricing scaffold — static layout first, CRM/CMS parameterization-ready numbered slots.

params.name: Matrix Eyebrow
params.description: Small uppercase label above the matrix heading.

params.name: Matrix Heading
params.description: Main heading for the comparison matrix.

params.default: Buildings, dispatch, automations, support and security across every tier.
params.name: Matrix Lede
params.description: Introductory paragraph for the matrix.

params.name: Collapsable
params.description: When true, desktop matrix feature groups can collapse behind their group headers. When false, groups stay open and no group collapse UI is initialized.

params.name: Collapsed by Default
params.description: Initial group state when Collapsable is true: true starts all desktop groups collapsed, false starts them open. Ignored when Collapsable is false.

params.name: Table Accessible Label
params.description: Accessible label for the matrix table.

params.name: Feature Column Label
params.description: Label for the leftmost feature column.

params.name: Plan Column Count
params.description: How many plan columns to render (2, 3, or 4). Hidden columns disappear from the desktop grid and the mobile accordion.

params.name: Collapsible Row Groups
params.description: When 'on', each desktop feature group gets a clickable title that collapses its rows (the mobile accordion is unaffected). Per-group default state is set by Group N Collapsed.

params.name: Row Hint Style
params.description: How each row's explanation (Row N Hint / Core PIM attribute Placeholder) is shown: 'inline' as gray subtext under the label, or 'tooltip' behind the feature label. The tooltip only appears on rows that actually have Placeholder text.

params.name: Tooltip Button Label
params.description: Accessible name for explanation triggers. Only relevant when Row Hint Style is 'tooltip'.

params.name: Default Billing Period
params.description: Initial billing period before any pricing.* block broadcasts a different one.

params.default: Final entitlements may depend on CRM rules. Talk to sales for custom matches.
params.name: Matrix Disclaimer
params.description: Small disclaimer shown below the matrix.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Enabled
params.description: Opts this block into loading Core PIM pricing. When false or when loading fails, the static matrix rows remain the rendered fallback.

params.name: Pricing API Base
params.description: Core PIM API base path or origin. The runtime removes a trailing /api and posts to /public/{organization}/catalog/price-comparison.json.

params.name: Pricing Organization
params.description: Core PIM organization code used in the public catalog URL.

params.name: Pricing Product Type Code
params.description: Core PIM product type to request, for example SERVICEWAND_SAAS, SERVICEWAND_SAAS_EXT, or SERVICEWAND_SAAS_ROUTING_TOKENS.

params.name: Pricing Sort Attribute Code
params.description: Product attribute used to sort plans before falling back to amount.

params.name: Pricing Price Type Code
params.description: Core PIM price type code for the request.

params.name: Pricing Price Attribute Code
params.description: Core PIM price attribute used to filter prices.

params.name: Pricing Price Attribute Values
params.description: Comma-separated price attribute values used by Core PIM filtering.

params.name: Pricing Currency
params.description: Currency attribute value requested from Core PIM.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Purchase URL
params.description: Fallback CTA destination used when the product CTA_LINK attribute is empty for dynamic plan columns.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Buy Label
params.description: Fallback CTA label used when the product CTA_LABEL attribute is empty for numeric pricing.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Contact Label
params.description: CTA/tag label for custom/contact pricing.

params.name: Dynamic Pricing Error Mode
params.description: Currently only fallback is supported: keep the static CMS-authored matrix if Core PIM loading fails.

notes: column_count drives the static fallback desktop grid track count. Dynamic mode derives the count from returned plans and sets the grid tracks at runtime.
Rows and groups can be hidden via row_NN_visible / group_NN_visible ENUMs without removing their params.
States 'yes' and 'partial' render a colored glyph; 'no' renders a quiet gray dash so the entry plan is not buried in red X marks. Use 'text' for human-readable amounts like '50K'.
Icon-only state cells get an aria-label from state_label_yes/no/partial via block.js.
Dynamic pricing is opt-in via dynamic_pricing_enabled. Static plan, group, and row fields remain the editor preview and fallback if the Core PIM request is disabled or fails.
Dynamic mode uses the shared 14-pricing/_shared/pricing-runtime.js loader and consumes normalized plan/group data; do not copy Core PIM response parsing into this block.
Dynamic matrix CTAs read product attributes CTA_LABEL and CTA_LINK first; section-level pricing_buy_label / pricing_purchase_url are fallbacks.
pricing_product_type_code can point at SERVICEWAND_SAAS, SERVICEWAND_SAAS_EXT, or SERVICEWAND_SAAS_ROUTING_TOKENS when the matching price type and attribute filters are supplied.
Dynamic matrix mode rebuilds table and accordion rows from visible Core PIM attribute groups, so it is not limited to the static twelve-row or four-column parameter model.
The table shell scrolls horizontally when dynamic mode returns more plan columns than fit comfortably.
cta_row_visible toggles the closing per-plan CTA row (desktop) and per-plan accordion CTAs (mobile) together.
The mobile accordion opens plan 02 by default — by catalog convention slot 02 is the featured/popular plan.
